zh-CN.title: 鄂尔多斯首日，我挑了四张
zh-CN.dek: CTCC 鄂尔多斯站，维修通道和主直道。

en.title: Four frames I kept from day one in Ordos
en.dek: The pit lane and main straight at CTCC Ordos.

zh-CN.text: 鄂尔多斯这组，我挺喜欢从上往下拍的那张。几台红车排在车库门口，车边还有人在走。竖着拍，通道能一直看到后面。

en.text: In the Ordos set, I like the frame looking down. Red cars line the garages and people are still walking around them. The vertical shot lets you see all the way down the pit lane.

zh-CN.caption: 维修通道里排着的赛车。

en.caption: Cars lined up in the pit lane.

zh-CN.text: 主直道那两张可以连着看。红车那张，我追着它横着过去，后面的看台基本只剩线。黄车那张留得宽一点，你还能看见顶棚和前面那段路。

en.text: The two frames from the main straight go together. I panned with the red car and the grandstand turned into lines behind it. I framed the yellow car wider, so the roof and the road ahead are still there.

zh-CN.caption: 红车驶过主直道。

en.caption: The red car on the main straight.

zh-CN.caption: 黄车从看台下经过。

en.caption: The yellow car passes under the grandstand.

zh-CN.text: 最后这张里，两台车离得很近，我就想把它们都留在画面里。看完单车，再翻到这张，第一眼会先去看它们之间那点距离。

en.text: The two cars are close in the last frame, so I wanted both in the picture. After the single-car shots, the first thing I look at here is the gap between them.

zh-CN.caption: 两台赛车并行。

en.caption: Two cars side by side.

zh-CN.alt_text: 从维修区上方俯看车列。
zh-CN.caption: 从维修区上方俯看车列。

en.alt_text: The pit-lane lineup from above.
en.caption: The pit-lane lineup from above.

zh-CN.alt_text: 红色赛车驶过主直道，背景随追拍拉成横线。
zh-CN.caption: 红色赛车驶过主直道，背景随追拍拉成横线。

en.alt_text: A red car on the main straight, with the background streaking in the pan.
en.caption: A red car on the main straight, with the background streaking in the pan.

zh-CN.alt_text: 黄车驶过看台下方，画面保留了直道和顶棚。
zh-CN.caption: 黄车驶过看台下方，画面保留了直道和顶棚。

en.alt_text: A yellow car beneath the grandstand, with the straight and roof in frame.
en.caption: A yellow car beneath the grandstand, with the straight and roof in frame.

zh-CN.alt_text: 两台赛车并行驶过主直道。
zh-CN.caption: 两台赛车并行驶过主直道。

en.alt_text: Two cars run side by side on the main straight.
en.caption: Two cars run side by side on the main straight.

zh-CN.title: 前滩那间 Vivienne Westwood Café
zh-CN.dek: 新店开业那次，我把 Café 单独拍了一组。

en.title: The Vivienne Westwood Café in Qiantan
en.dek: I made a separate set of café pictures during the store opening.

zh-CN.text: 从商场走过去，先看到吧台和这块浅蓝色的板。竖着拍，入口和里面点单的地方都在。

en.text: Walking up from the mall, you see the counter and the pale blue panel first. The vertical frame takes in the entrance and the place where you order.

zh-CN.caption: Café 入口和吧台。

en.caption: The café entrance and counter.

zh-CN.text: 往右看就是红电话亭和街景装置。开业时很容易被这片红色吸引，我也拍了一张稍远的，把它跟店铺入口放在一起。

en.text: Look to the right and there’s the red phone box. It’s what catches your eye, so I stepped back for a frame that shows where it sits next to the shop.

zh-CN.caption: 电话亭和街景装置。

en.caption: The phone box and street display.

zh-CN.text: 最后是门边的字。红字配浅蓝底，我喜欢这个颜色，单独留了一张。

en.text: The lettering by the door caught my eye too. I liked the red against the pale blue and kept a frame of it on its own.

zh-CN.caption: 门边的 Café 字标。

en.caption: Café lettering by the door.

zh-CN.caption: Café 吧台与薄荷绿色品牌标识墙

en.caption: Café counter and mint-green branded wall
en.alt_text: Café counter and mint-green branded wall

en.caption: British streetscape installation with red seating
en.alt_text: British streetscape installation with red seating

zh-CN.title: 从前滩店的弧形柜台看进去
zh-CN.dek: Vivienne Westwood 前滩新店的门头、柜台和休息区。

en.title: Inside the Qiantan store
en.dek: The entrance, counter and seating area at the new Vivienne Westwood store.

zh-CN.text: 我挺喜欢店中间这个弧形柜台。地面的字顺着它往里走，镜子里还能看见另一边的陈列。

en.text: I like the curved counter in the middle of the shop. The lettering on the floor leads you around it, and you can see more of the display in the mirrors.

zh-CN.caption: 店内的弧形柜台。

en.caption: The curved counter inside the shop.

zh-CN.text: 从外面看，左边是店铺，右边是 Café。两边离得很近，拍门头时干脆放在同一张里。

en.text: From outside, the shop is on the left and the café is on the right. They’re close enough that I could get both into the entrance shot.

zh-CN.caption: 店铺和 Café 的入口。

en.caption: The entrances to the shop and café.

zh-CN.text: 往里走还有沙发。从柜台旁边朝那个方向拍，前面能看到陈列，后面是坐的地方。

en.text: There’s a sofa farther in. Looking past the counter, you get the display in front and somewhere to sit at the back.

zh-CN.caption: 从陈列柜看向休息区。

en.caption: Looking past the display toward the seating area.

zh-CN.caption: 弧形珠宝展示柜与店内全景

zh-CN.title: 柜台里的珍珠、Orb 和腕表
zh-CN.dek: 前滩 Vivienne Westwood 开业，现场柜台里拍的三张静物。

en.title: Pearls, the Orb and watches in the display case
en.dek: Three still lifes photographed in the display case during the Qiantan opening.

zh-CN.text: 这几张就在前滩店的柜台里拍。先从上往下看，珍珠一圈一圈绕在卡片上，旁边还能看见几件饰品。

en.text: I took these inside the shop’s display case. From above you can see the pearls curled around the card and a few of the other pieces beside them.

zh-CN.caption: 柜台里的珍珠饰品。

en.caption: Pearl jewellery in the display case.

zh-CN.text: 黑色托盘那张我留了一点柜灯的反光。看得出是在店里拍的，托盘上的饰品也看得清。

en.text: I left a little reflection from the case lights in the shot of the black tray. You can still see the jewellery, and you can tell where it was photographed.

zh-CN.caption: 黑色托盘上的饰品和柜灯反光。

en.caption: Jewellery on the black tray with reflections from the case lighting.

zh-CN.text: 到腕表就再近一点。粉色表盘很小，放大了才看得清它和金属表带之间的颜色。

en.text: I went closer for the watch. The pink dial is small, and from here you can see the colour against the metal bracelet.

zh-CN.caption: 粉色表盘与金属表带。

en.caption: Pink dial and metal bracelet.

zh-CN.caption: 金色与银色 Orb 珍珠项链
zh-CN.alt_text: 金色与银色 Orb 珍珠项链

en.caption: Pearl necklaces with gold-coloured and silver-coloured Orb pendants
en.alt_text: Pearl necklaces with gold-coloured and silver-coloured Orb pendants

zh-CN.caption: 珍珠表带腕表与 Orb 手链
zh-CN.alt_text: 珍珠表带腕表与 Orb 手链

en.caption: Pearl-bracelet watch and Orb bracelet
en.alt_text: Pearl-bracelet watch and Orb bracelet

zh-CN.caption: 花卉图案表盘与金属表带特写
zh-CN.alt_text: 花卉图案表盘与金属表带特写

zh-CN.title: 美时维的钟表工作台
zh-CN.dek: 钟表 DIY 培训那天，我拍了照片，也拍了全程视频。

en.title: At the TreasureCare workbench
en.dek: I photographed the watchmaking workshop and filmed the full session.

zh-CN.text: 美时维工坊这次做的是钟表 DIY。桌边有人在指导，学员低头看手里的零件。我喜欢从两个人中间带到桌面，能看到他们在看同一个东西。

en.text: At the TreasureCare workshop, an instructor guides a participant who’s looking down at the parts. I like the angle that catches both people and the workbench. You can see what has their attention.

zh-CN.caption: 工作台边的指导和操作。

en.caption: An instructor and participant at the workbench.

zh-CN.text: 有些动作一抬头就错过了。靠近拍工具压下去的那一下，手怎么拿着零件也能一起看清楚。

en.text: Some movements are over as soon as you look up. From close in, you can see how the hand holds the part when the tool comes down.

zh-CN.caption: 手部操作和工作台上的工具。

en.caption: Hands and tools at the workbench.

zh-CN.text: 换到另一侧，有人在旁边看，有人继续做。我把视频留给完整过程，照片里可以停下来多看一会儿。

en.text: From the other side, some people are watching and others keep working. The film follows the whole process. The photographs let you stop and look.

zh-CN.caption: 另一侧的工作台。

en.caption: The workbench from the other side.

zh-CN.alt_text: 美时维工坊｜钟表 DIY 培训影像现场照片 03

zh-CN.title: 做好的表，放回托盘里看
zh-CN.dek: 美时维工坊的成品静物，近看表盘，再看整盘。

en.title: The finished watches in their trays
en.dek: The finished watches from TreasureCare, from a dial close-up to the whole tray.

zh-CN.text: 拍完美时维的培训，我又单独拍了这些做好的表。先看这只，灰色托盘很安静，表盘上的纹理就比较明显。

en.text: After the workshop I photographed the finished watches on their own. In this first frame, the plain grey tray makes the dial texture easy to see.

zh-CN.caption: 灰色托盘里的一只成品表。

en.caption: One finished watch in a grey tray.

zh-CN.text: 两盘放在一起就更有意思了。每个人做的颜色和图案都不一样，俯拍一张，能一格一格慢慢看。

en.text: The two trays are interesting together. The colours and patterns vary from watch to watch. From overhead, you can go through them one compartment at a time.

zh-CN.caption: 两盘成品的俯拍。

en.caption: An overhead view of the two trays.

zh-CN.text: 最后这只蓝色表盘，我把旁边两格留了一点。这样还能看出来它摆在整盘的哪个位置。

en.text: On the blue dial I left a little of the compartments around it, so you can still place it in the tray.

zh-CN.caption: 蓝色表盘特写。

en.caption: A close-up of the blue dial.

zh-CN.title: 在招行私人银行听一场制表讲座
zh-CN.dek: 和美时维一起记录 Gerald Charles 的制表文化分享。

en.title: A watchmaking talk at China Merchants Bank
en.dek: A Gerald Charles watchmaking talk with TreasureCare.

zh-CN.text: 这场和美时维合作，在招商银行私人银行拍 Gerald Charles 的制表文化讲座。进门先看会场，桌椅、屏幕和展示区各在哪儿，拍一张就有了。

en.text: I worked with TreasureCare to photograph a Gerald Charles talk at China Merchants Bank Private Banking. From the entrance, one frame shows where the seats, screen and display are.

zh-CN.caption: 招行私人银行的讲座会场。

en.caption: The room at China Merchants Bank Private Banking.

zh-CN.text: 讲到腕表的时候，我往前靠了一点。讲者的手势和屏幕上的表放在一起，回头看照片也知道当时在聊什么。

en.text: When the speaker got to the watches, I moved closer. With the gesture and the watch on screen in one frame, you can tell what the talk was about.

zh-CN.caption: 讲者和屏幕上的腕表。

en.caption: The speaker with a watch on screen.

zh-CN.text: 换到听众那边，视线跟着讲者手指的方向走。客户挑活动回顾的照片时，这张跟前面的近景都用得上。

en.text: From the audience side, your eye follows where the speaker points. This frame and the close-up can both work in a recap of the event.

zh-CN.caption: 从听众席看讲解。

en.caption: The talk from the audience side.

zh-CN.title: Brand SA 在丽晶酒店的那一晚
zh-CN.dek: 上海浦东丽晶酒店里的南非社群交流活动。

en.title: An evening with Brand SA at the Regent
en.dek: A South African community event at the Regent Shanghai Pudong.

zh-CN.text: Brand SA 这场是在上海浦东丽晶酒店拍的。嘉宾发言的时候，背后是 Global South Africans Network 的大屏，站近一点，人和活动名字都能看清。

en.text: I photographed this Brand SA event at the Regent Shanghai Pudong. The Global South Africans Network screen was behind the speaker. Closer in, you can read the name and still see the person clearly.

zh-CN.caption: 发言嘉宾与现场大屏。

en.caption: A speaker with the event screen behind him.

zh-CN.text: 我也留了一张空一点的会场。深色的墙、桌布和屏幕上的黄箭头，跟发言那张放在一起就知道是同一个地方。

en.text: I also kept a frame with more of the room in it. The dark walls and tablecloths, and the yellow arrow on the screen, put the speaker’s picture in context.

zh-CN.caption: 活动会场和现场陈设。

en.caption: The room and event setup.

zh-CN.text: 那晚我用了索尼 50–150mm F2 GM。十张选片里有六张是 F2，这张来宾肖像可以看看近处的灯和后面的人怎么虚开。

en.text: I used the Sony 50–150mm F2 GM that evening. Six of the ten selected frames were at F2. In this portrait you can see how the lights in front and people behind the guest fall out of focus.

zh-CN.caption: 会场里的来宾肖像。

en.caption: A guest portrait in the room.

zh-CN.title: 东方艺术中心，台上和台下
zh-CN.dek: 厦门爱歌合唱团演出，我留下了几个不同距离的画面。

en.title: Onstage and in the audience at the Oriental Art Center
en.dek: I photographed the Xiamen Aige Choir from a few different distances.

zh-CN.text: 厦门爱歌合唱团请我拍这场演出。离舞台远一点，能看见台上亮着，观众席里也有一片亮点。开头放这张，我喜欢它把两边都带进来了。

en.text: The Xiamen Aige Choir asked me to photograph this performance. From farther back, you can see the lit stage and the little lights in the audience. I like starting with both in the picture.

zh-CN.caption: 舞台和观众席里的星光。

en.caption: The stage and lights in the audience.

zh-CN.text: 正面再来一张，指挥、合唱团和钢琴都能找到。拍演出时我会给这样的全景留一张。

en.text: From the front you can find the conductor, choir and piano. I make room for a wide frame like this when I cover a performance.

zh-CN.caption: 合唱团演出的正面全景。

en.caption: A frontal view of the choir onstage.

zh-CN.text: 拉近以后就可以看人。话筒一拿起来，前面的人跟后排团员都在画面里，我就留了这一张。

en.text: Closer in, you can watch the people. Once the microphone came up, I kept this frame with the person in front and choir members behind.

zh-CN.caption: 舞台上的发言和后排团员。

zh-CN.title: For Me / Eletre X 试驾那天，我拍了什么
zh-CN.dek: 莲花的国际媒体试驾，我负责平面和现场图片协调。

en.title: What I photographed at the For Me / Eletre X drive
en.dek: I handled stills and coordinated photo requests at Lotus’s international media drive.

zh-CN.text: 莲花这场国际媒体试驾，车停在外面时，我会留几张车辆和现场都能看懂的照片。像这张，白车的前脸和旁边交流的人都在。

en.text: At the Lotus media drive I made some frames that showed the cars in the setting. This one has the front of the white car and the people talking beside it.

zh-CN.caption: 试驾现场的白色 For Me。

en.caption: A white For Me at the media drive.

zh-CN.text: 到车里又是另一张照片。人一坐进驾驶席，方向盘、座椅颜色和他的姿势就都能拍到。

en.text: Inside the car there’s another picture. Once he’s in the driver’s seat, you can get his posture, the wheel and the colour of the seats together.

zh-CN.caption: 驾驶席里的媒体来宾。

en.caption: A media guest in the driver’s seat.

en.text: I made portraits beside the car as well. I also worked out what the overseas media needed and when we could shoot it. In the delivery, both the people and the cars needed to be easy to find.

zh-CN.title: Evija 的黑漆，刚好接住顶灯
zh-CN.dek: 在上海拍路特斯 Evija 展车时，顶上的格子灯很有意思。

en.title: The lights in the Evija’s black paint
en.dek: The ceiling grid caught my eye while photographing the Lotus Evija in Shanghai.

zh-CN.text: 黑色 Evija 放在格子灯下面，第一眼能看到车顶和车头的反光。我给车身留了点距离，地上的黄线也能进来。

en.text: Under the grid lights, the first thing you see on the black Evija is the reflection on its roof and nose. I left enough space around the car for the yellow line on the floor.

zh-CN.caption: 格子灯下的黑色 Evija。

en.caption: The black Evija beneath the ceiling grid.

zh-CN.text: 机位往侧边走一点，反光就换了一块。车身两侧怎么往下收，这时候更好看出来。

en.text: Move sideways a little and the reflection shifts. From here you can see more of how the sides curve down.

zh-CN.caption: 从另一侧看车身和顶灯。

en.caption: The bodywork and lights from another angle.

zh-CN.text: 最后一张，我留了右边那块墙。车头只露一部分，墙上的黄带跟地上那条线接得上。

en.text: I kept the wall on the right of the last picture. Only part of the nose shows, and the yellow strip on the wall picks up the line on the floor.

zh-CN.caption: 墙边露出的车头。

en.caption: The nose of the car beside the wall.

zh-CN.title: 四明山，跟着车走一段
zh-CN.dek: Lotus、GR Yaris 和 911 Carrera GTS 敞篷的山路照片。

en.title: Following the cars through Siming Mountain
en.dek: A Lotus, GR Yaris and 911 Carrera GTS Cabriolet on the mountain roads.

zh-CN.text: 宁波四明山这趟，同行有 Lotus、Toyota GR Yaris 和 Porsche 911 Carrera GTS 敞篷，车手刘瑞琦也在。我拍了路上的车，也拍了停下来的时候。

en.text: The Siming Mountain drive in Ningbo brought together a Lotus, a Toyota GR Yaris and a Porsche 911 Carrera GTS Cabriolet. Driver Liu Ruiqi joined us. I photographed the cars moving and when we stopped.

zh-CN.caption: 山路上的黄色 Lotus。

en.caption: The yellow Lotus on the mountain road.

zh-CN.text: 这张是随车拍的，前面的红色车身也留了一点。弯道和后面的车刚好都看得见。

en.text: I made this frame from the moving car and kept a little of the red bodywork in front. You can see both the bend and the car behind.

zh-CN.caption: 从车里回看弯道。

en.caption: Looking back into the bend from the car.

zh-CN.text: 停下来以后，路边的树和车又是另一个样子。走完那一段再翻到这张，我还是能记得在那里停过。

en.text: When we stopped, the trees and cars looked different. Coming back to this frame after the driving pictures, I remember that spot.

zh-CN.caption: 途中停下来的车。

en.caption: The cars stopped along the way.

zh-CN.title: 天马赛道日，三次看车
zh-CN.dek: 一张在弯里，一张在直道，还有一张从上往下拍。

en.title: Three views from a Tianma track day
en.dek: A bend, the straight and a view from above.

zh-CN.text: 天马这张黄车，我先看的是过弯时的车身。背景留得简单，轮廓和车在路上的方向都比较清楚。

en.text: The first thing I look at in the yellow-car frame is how the body sits through the bend. The background is simple enough to read the shape and the direction it’s heading.

zh-CN.caption: 弯道里的黄车。

en.caption: The yellow car in the bend.

zh-CN.text: 红车这张是追着拍的，画面里的地面和远处都往一个方向拉过去。选片的时候我把它放在黄车后面，速度看起来不一样。

en.text: I panned with the red car. The road and the distance streak in the same direction. I put it after the yellow car in the edit because the speed feels different.

zh-CN.caption: 直道上的红车追拍。

en.caption: A pan of the red car on the straight.

zh-CN.text: 换到上面看，白车在路中间，两边的线都留着。拍赛道日我也会选这种角度，翻到这一张能看一眼路本身。

en.text: From above, the white car is in the middle and you can see the lines on either side. I like a frame like this on a track day because you get a look at the road itself.

zh-CN.caption: 从上方拍经过的白车。

en.caption: The white car from above.

zh-CN.title: 中信泰富的西太后圣诞树
zh-CN.dek: 先拍室外的树，再走进店里拍当天的活动。

en.title: The Vivienne Westwood Christmas tree at CITIC Square
en.dek: I started with the tree outside, then went into the shop to photograph the event.

zh-CN.text: 从中信泰富外面抬头，圣诞树上的 Orb 很显眼。往上拍，后面还能看见商场外墙。

en.text: Looking up from outside CITIC Square, the Orb on the Christmas tree stands out. The mall facade is still there behind it.

zh-CN.caption: 中信泰富室外的圣诞树。

en.caption: The Christmas tree outside CITIC Square.

zh-CN.text: 我也拍了一张稍远的竖图。把树上的饰品和旁边的楼一起留住，就看得出来这棵树有多高。

en.text: I made a wider vertical frame too. Keeping the ornaments and the building beside the tree gives you a better idea of its height.

zh-CN.caption: 从远一点看树和商场。

en.caption: The tree and mall from farther back.

zh-CN.text: 到店里是另一种画面。有人在桌前画，有人坐着看。拍到这儿，才算把那天店里发生的事也带上了。

en.text: Inside the shop it was different. Someone was drawing at the table and others sat watching. I wanted the pictures to show what was happening indoors too.

zh-CN.caption: 店内的绘画互动。

en.caption: Drawing at the table inside the shop.

zh-CN.dek: 梦百合 × 曼联嘉年华上海站，舞台、球场和签名桌。

en.title: Andy Cole signing shirts for fans
en.dek: The stage, pitch and signing table at the MLILY and Manchester United carnival in Shanghai.

zh-CN.text: 上海汶水商场那场梦百合 × 曼联嘉年华，安迪·科尔到场。舞台合影先把嘉宾和活动名字交代清楚。

en.text: Andy Cole came to the MLILY and Manchester United carnival at the Wenshui mall. The group photo onstage shows the guests and the event name.

zh-CN.caption: 嘉年华舞台合影。

en.caption: The group photograph onstage.

zh-CN.text: 从楼上往下拍，才看得见商场中庭怎么摆的。中间做了块小球场，周围都是观众区。

en.text: From upstairs you can see the layout of the atrium. There was a little pitch in the middle with seating around it.

zh-CN.caption: 从楼上看中庭和小球场。

en.caption: The atrium and pitch from upstairs.

zh-CN.text: 我最愿意留下的是签名桌这张。红球衣递到桌前，科尔低头签，画面边上还有人的手。

en.text: The signing table is the frame I most wanted to keep. A red shirt comes across the table, Cole looks down to sign it, and you can still see hands at the edge.

zh-CN.caption: 安迪·科尔在签红色球衣。

en.caption: Andy Cole signs a red shirt.

zh-CN.dek: 在上海前滩香格里拉拍到的三个画面。

en.title: The red carpet and interview area at the Forbes beauty awards
en.dek: Three frames from the event at the Shangri-La in Qiantan.

zh-CN.text: 这次我在前滩香格里拉拍福布斯中国美业品牌100颁奖盛典的红毯和采访。到采访区，话筒和背景上的字我都留着，照片能看出她正在接受采访。

en.text: I covered the red carpet and interview area at the Forbes China beauty awards in Qiantan. In the interview picture I kept the microphones and the lettering behind her so you can tell what she’s doing.

zh-CN.caption: 采访区的话筒和活动背景。

en.caption: Microphones and backdrop in the interview area.

zh-CN.text: 红毯上是另一种光，红色灯条把人物勾出来。拍全身的时候，我留了一点两边的线。

en.text: The light on the red carpet was different. The red strips outline the subject. I left some of the lines on either side in the full-length frame.

zh-CN.caption: 红色灯条前的红毯肖像。

en.caption: A red-carpet portrait in front of the red light strips.

zh-CN.text: 靠近之后，灯条就退到旁边，注意力回到人脸和礼服上。

en.text: Move closer and the lights slip to the side. Your eye goes back to the face and the dress.

zh-CN.caption: 拉近后的人物和礼服。

en.caption: A closer view of the subject and dress.

zh-CN.title: 在录音棚听一场大提琴
zh-CN.dek: 西音的这场演奏会，我拍了台上的琴，也拍了台下的手机。

en.title: Cello in the recording studio
en.dek: At Xiyin I photographed the instruments onstage and a phone in the audience.

zh-CN.text: 西音录音棚不大，大提琴和钢琴在同一片暖光里。先留一张两个人都在的，回头看就知道演奏是什么样的。

en.text: The Xiyin studio is small. The cello and piano sit in the same warm light. I kept a frame with both players so you can see how they were set up.

zh-CN.caption: 大提琴和钢琴同台。

en.caption: Cello and piano onstage together.

zh-CN.text: 再近一点，就能看见弓和琴弦。照片里看不到声音，手正在做什么倒是可以留下来。

en.text: Closer in, you can see the bow and strings. You can’t hear the picture, but you can see what the hands are doing.

zh-CN.caption: 演奏者和弓弦。

en.caption: The player, bow and strings.

zh-CN.text: 最后一张是从观众后面拍的。有人举手机，屏幕里是清楚的舞台，手机外面反而虚了。我挺喜欢这个角度。

en.text: I took the last one from behind the audience. Someone held up a phone. The stage is sharp on the screen and soft outside it. I like that angle.

zh-CN.caption: 从观众举起的手机里看舞台。

en.caption: The stage on a phone held up by someone in the audience.

zh-CN.title: OMEN 定妆照，同一个背景拍不同的人
zh-CN.dek: 灯和机位大致一样，每个人的动作留给他自己。

en.title: One backdrop for the OMEN portraits
en.dek: I kept the light and camera position consistent and let people find their own pose.

zh-CN.text: 给惠普 OMEN 项目成员拍定妆照，背景和构图先定下来。有人双手抱在胸前，站得很稳，这个姿势就挺合适。

en.text: For the HP OMEN portraits I settled on the backdrop and framing first. One person stood with his arms folded and looked comfortable there, so I kept it.

zh-CN.caption: 抱臂站在红色字样前。

en.caption: Arms folded in front of the red lettering.

zh-CN.text: 换一个人，手放在腰上，站姿就变了。照片连着看是一套，人还是各有各的样子。

en.text: The next person put a hand on her hip and changed the shape of the pose. The photographs still go together, and you can see the difference between people.

zh-CN.caption: 同一背景下的另一种站姿。

en.caption: A different stance against the same backdrop.

zh-CN.text: 还有人抬手比了个动作。这种我会保留，比每个人都站成一样好看。

en.text: Someone else made a sign with his hand. I like to keep frames like this. They’re better than making everyone stand the same way.

zh-CN.caption: 抬手比动作的项目成员。

en.caption: A team member making a hand gesture.

zh-CN.title: 中船动力，一天里几个要拍到的环节
zh-CN.dek: 合影、技术参观和培训，我按当天的内容交图。

en.title: A day at CSSC Power, in a few frames
en.dek: The group photo, technical tour and training were all part of the delivery.

zh-CN.text: 中船动力这天有揭牌、培训、参观和合影。合影在门口拍，背景里有公司名字，客户以后需要一张能代表当天活动的照片，这张就好找。

en.text: The CSSC Power event included an unveiling, training, a tour and a group photo. We took the group photo outside with the company name behind them. It gives the client an easy frame to find for the event as a whole.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力门口的合影。

en.caption: Group photograph outside CSSC Power.

zh-CN.text: 参观的时候我跟着往里走。走廊这张能看见谁在讲、其他人往哪儿看，跟合影是两种信息。

en.text: I followed the group inside for the tour. In the corridor you can see who’s speaking and where the others are looking. It tells you something different from the group photo.

zh-CN.caption: 技术参观时的交流。

en.caption: A conversation during the technical tour.

zh-CN.text: 培训再去拍讲台，屏幕上写的内容尽量留一点。回来我按环节整理，找哪一段就去翻哪一组。

en.text: For the training I went back to the lectern and kept some of the text on screen. I organise the delivery by event segment so people can go straight to the pictures they need.

zh-CN.caption: 培训现场的讲台。

en.caption: The lectern during the training.

en.title: Before the group photo at Yichi Garden
en.dek: Exercises, facilitation and participants at a drama workshop.

zh-CN.text: 一尺花园这场，合影有了，我更想再翻翻过程。大家最后站在一起之前，做过好几段练习。

en.text: At Yichi Garden I had the group photo, and I wanted to go back through the exercises too. There was a lot happening before everyone came together.

zh-CN.caption: 一尺花园的活动合影。

en.caption: The group photo at Yichi Garden.

zh-CN.text: 有一张是引导者站在前面说话，后面的人看着她。我留了一点旁边的空间，让大家怎么站还能看得出来。

en.text: In one frame the facilitator is speaking and people behind her are watching. I kept some space at the side so you can see how they’re standing.

zh-CN.caption: 练习开始前的现场引导。

en.caption: The facilitator addressing the group.

zh-CN.text: 还有一段大家坐下来一起练习。这个时候靠近一点，谁在低头看、谁在伸手就清楚了。

en.text: In another exercise the group sat down together. From closer in you can see who’s looking down and who’s reaching out.

zh-CN.caption: 坐下来一起做练习。

en.caption: The group sits down for an exercise.

zh-CN.title: Te Amo，三十岁的红房间
zh-CN.dek: 一张入口的牌、一盏桌灯，还有生日主角。

en.title: A red room for a thirtieth at Te Amo
en.dek: A sign at the entrance, a table lamp and the person whose birthday it was.

zh-CN.text: Te Amo 这场三十岁生日，一进去就看到红色。门边放了张牌，我先拍了一张，旁边店里的灯也露了一点。

en.text: At this thirtieth birthday at Te Amo, the red hits you as you walk in. I started with the sign at the entrance, with a little of the light from inside.

zh-CN.caption: 入口的生日布置。

en.caption: The birthday sign at the entrance.

zh-CN.text: 往里有张小桌子，红墙前摆着一盏彩色的灯。这张拍得安静一点，后面看人像时还能认出是同一个房间。

en.text: Inside there was a little table with a coloured lamp against the red wall. It’s a quiet frame, and you can recognise the room later when you get to the portrait.

zh-CN.caption: 红墙前的桌灯。

en.caption: The table lamp against the red wall.

zh-CN.text: 主角站到旁边，白衣服和后面的红刚好分开。她手里拿着花，我就留了这一张。

en.text: When she stood beside the table, her white outfit stood out against the red. She was holding flowers, and I kept that frame.

zh-CN.caption: 红房间里的生日肖像。

en.caption: A birthday portrait in the red room.

zh-CN.dek: 在上海宝格丽拍的一场私人聚会。

en.title: Friends in the frame at a Shanghai proposal
en.dek: A private gathering at the Bulgari in Shanghai.

zh-CN.text: 拍求婚那组时，我也转过去拍了朋友。有人举着手机，旁边的人还在看那边。回来看照片，这些反应挺有意思。

en.text: While photographing the proposal, I turned to the friends as well. Someone held up a phone and the people beside her were still watching. I like coming back to those reactions.

zh-CN.caption: 亲友拿出手机记录。

en.caption: Friends take out a phone to record the moment.

zh-CN.text: 往后退一点，整张桌子和两边的人就都进来了。靠得很近的时候，反而很难知道大家坐在哪儿。

en.text: A step back takes in the whole table and the people on either side. From close up it’s hard to tell where everyone was sitting.

zh-CN.caption: 整桌亲友的远景。

en.caption: A wider frame of friends and family at the table.

zh-CN.text: 还有一张是人站起来以后拍的。桌边的人还坐着，顶灯也没离开画面，我就把这个时刻留了下来。

en.text: I made another frame after someone stood up. People were still seated around the table and the lamp stayed in view, so I kept that moment too.

zh-CN.caption: 聚会中从座位起身的一刻。

en.caption: A moment as someone stands up during the gathering.

en.title: A tenth birthday, with cake and city lights
en.dek: A few frames of the child with family.

zh-CN.text: 窗边那张，孩子和家人站在生日牌旁边。窗外的灯已经亮起来了，我给后面多留了一点。

en.text: By the window, the child and family stood beside the birthday sign. The lights outside were already on, so I left some room for the view.

zh-CN.caption: 生日牌旁的窗边合照。

en.caption: A family photo by the birthday sign and window.

zh-CN.text: 到蛋糕前，家人站在孩子旁边，桌边还有人在看。我喜欢这张能看见他和家人待在一起的样子。

en.text: At the cake, a family member was beside him and others were watching from the table. I like that you can see what it was like to be there with the family.

zh-CN.caption: 蛋糕前的孩子和家人。

en.caption: The child with family in front of the cake.

zh-CN.text: 最后拍了一张孩子自己的。后面还是气球和生日牌，跟合照放一起就能看出来是同一天。

en.text: I kept a frame of the child on his own too. The balloons and sign are still behind him, so it sits naturally beside the family picture.

zh-CN.caption: 气球和生日牌前的肖像。

en.caption: A portrait in front of the balloons and birthday sign.

en.title: Three frames beside the wedding car
en.dek: A few Shanghai wedding frames, from beside the car to looking through its window.

zh-CN.text: 婚车旁边这张，两个人刚好靠在一起。捧花在手里，后面还能看见车，我没把画面收得太紧。

en.text: Beside the wedding car, the two of them leaned together. The bouquet is still in her hand and you can see the car behind them. I left some room around them.

zh-CN.caption: 新人在婚车旁。

zh-CN.text: 有亲友走到车边，弯下去跟里面的人说话。这个动作一会儿就过去，我喜欢留这样的画面。

en.text: A guest came over and bent down to talk to the person inside. It was over quickly. I like keeping frames like that.

zh-CN.caption: 在车旁俯身说话的亲友。

en.caption: A guest leans down to talk through the car door.

zh-CN.text: 新娘坐进车里以后，我从窗外拍了一张。车窗自己就有个框，她坐在里面，外面的人也能看见她。

en.text: Once the bride sat inside I took a frame from outside. The window makes its own frame around her.

zh-CN.caption: 从车窗外拍新娘。

en.caption: The bride photographed through the car window.

zh-CN.title: 照片拍完，客户怎么用？
zh-CN.dek: 拿花小念和中船动力两个项目来说。

en.title: What happens to the photos after the shoot?
en.dek: Two examples, from Huaxiaonian and CSSC Power.

zh-CN.text: 花小念这组，我先看人坐到花旁边是什么样。花已经够抢眼了，背景和衣服就少抢一点。那件牛仔服留在照片里，我觉得刚好。

en.text: With the Huaxiaonian shoot, I started by looking at how the person sat beside the flowers. The arrangement already draws the eye. The denim works for me because it leaves the flowers room.

zh-CN.caption: 花小念，花艺和坐在旁边的人。

en.caption: Huaxiaonian, with the arrangement and the person seated beside it.

zh-CN.text: 到中船动力，客户要找的可能就是一张揭牌照。培训、参观、交流和合影也各有用途。选片的时候，我会先把这些环节对一遍。

en.text: At CSSC Power, the client might be looking for the unveiling. The training, tour, conversations and group photo each have a use. I check for all of them when I edit.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力揭牌。

en.caption: The unveiling at CSSC Power.

zh-CN.text: 参观也一样。离设备近一点，能看见大家在看什么。这张放回整组里，读到的就是参观现场。

en.text: The tour works the same way. Get closer to the equipment and you can see what people are looking at. That’s the frame that tells you what the tour was like.

zh-CN.caption: 来宾围在设备旁。

en.caption: Guests gather around the equipment.

zh-CN.text: 开拍前我会问，照片给谁看，哪天要用，有哪几张一定得拍。公众号、网站和内部汇报用图都不太一样。用途说清楚，回来排照片就好办很多。

en.text: Before a shoot I ask who the pictures are for, when they’re needed and what we have to get. A WeChat post, a website and an internal report call for different pictures. Knowing where they’ll go makes the edit easier.

zh-CN.title: 先看他们在做什么
zh-CN.dek: 梗犬美容沙龙和一尺花园，两场活动里我留意的几个动作。

en.title: Watch what people are doing
en.dek: A few moments I noticed at a terrier grooming session and a workshop at Yichi Garden.

zh-CN.text: 梗犬美容沙龙那天，大家围着一张桌子看示范。有的人举着手机，有的人直接凑过去看。我挺喜欢这张全景，刚好能看见大家的注意力都在哪儿。

en.text: At the grooming session, people gathered around one table. Some held up their phones. Others leaned right in. I like the wide shot because you can tell what everyone is looking at.

zh-CN.caption: 大家围在操作台旁看示范。

en.caption: The group watches a demonstration at the grooming table.

zh-CN.text: 换到桌边，手怎么扶住狗、工具在什么位置，才能看清楚。

en.text: From beside the table you can see how the groomer holds the dog and where the tools are.

zh-CN.caption: 操作台上的手和梗犬。

en.caption: The groomer’s hands and the terrier on the table.

zh-CN.text: 一尺花园那场，几个人面对面站着。谁在说，谁听完接上去，这些小动作挺好拍。给他们留一点空间，等动作自己发生。

en.text: At Yichi Garden, participants stood facing one another. I watched who was speaking and who picked up after them. It helped to give them some room and wait.

zh-CN.caption: 一尺花园的面对面练习。

en.caption: A face-to-face exercise at Yichi Garden.

zh-CN.text: 回来选片，我会把动作和旁边人的反应放在一起看。先看得懂在做什么，再看现场的人怎么接这个动作。

en.text: In the edit I look at the action and the reactions together. First you see what’s happening, then how the people around it respond.

zh-CN.title: 同一台 S5II，拍三种现场
zh-CN.dek: 书院民宿、滴水湖和一场求婚，都是用 S5II 拍的。

en.title: Three shoots with the S5II
en.dek: I used the S5II at a guesthouse, a lakeside run and a proposal.

zh-CN.text: 书院民宿这张，机位往旁边挪一点，窗、浴缸和椅子的位置就会变。拍这种房间，我会先站在里面看看这些东西怎么摆，再选焦段。

en.text: Move a little in this guesthouse room and the relationship between the window, bath and chair changes. I start by looking at how the room is laid out, then choose the focal length.

zh-CN.caption: 书院民宿，窗边的客房。

en.caption: A guest room at Shuyuan Guesthouse.

zh-CN.text: 滴水湖那天拍的是跑动的人。S5II 的相位混合对焦有用，站哪儿也一样重要。我想把跑步的方向和那条长影子留下来，按快门之前得给它们留地方。

en.text: At Dishui Lake I was photographing someone running. The S5II’s phase hybrid autofocus helps. Where I stand matters too. I wanted the direction of travel and the long shadow in the picture, so I left room for them before pressing the shutter.

zh-CN.caption: 跑步者和路上的长影子。

en.caption: The runner and a long shadow on the path.

zh-CN.text: 拍上海那场求婚，我还留了一张整桌。往后退一点，能看清亲友坐在哪里。要是每张都贴着人拍，这一桌的气氛就没了。

en.text: At the Shanghai proposal I also made a picture of the whole table. Stepping back shows where friends and family were sitting. You’d lose the feel of the room if every frame were a close-up.

zh-CN.caption: 求婚聚会上的整桌画面。

en.caption: The full table at the proposal gathering.

zh-CN.text: 拍导览片的时候，我反而先操心讲话能不能听清。像浦东美术馆那支，收音、字幕和剪辑得一起想。不同项目，我出门前最先检查的东西也不一样。

en.text: For a guided film, the first thing I worry about is whether you can hear the speaker. On the Museum of Art Pudong film, sound, subtitles and the edit had to work together. What I check first before leaving depends on the job.

zh-CN.title: 我是 Richard，RFG 是我在上海做的工作室
zh-CN.dek: 从平潭的赛车到浦东美术馆，放几件我实际做过的事。

en.title: I’m Richard. RFG is my studio in Shanghai
en.dek: A few jobs I’ve worked on, from motorsport in Pingtan to the Museum of Art Pudong.

zh-CN.text: RFG 是 Rich First Generation。我在上海做摄影、影片和后期。品牌活动、汽车、人物、空间，网站上这些项目都是工作室平时做的事。

en.text: RFG stands for Rich First Generation. I do photography, film and post-production in Shanghai. Brand events, cars, people and interiors are all part of the work you see here.

zh-CN.caption: 中船动力活动合影。

en.caption: Group photograph at the CSSC Power event.

zh-CN.text: 我本来就喜欢车。去平潭拍莲花车队，除了看车，我也会在维修区多待一会儿。车手把头盔拿起来，旁边的人还在忙，这些都是我愿意留在组照里的画面。

en.text: I’ve always liked cars. When I photographed the Lotus team in Pingtan I spent time in the garage as well as looking at the cars. A driver reaching for a helmet with the crew still at work is the sort of frame I like to keep.

zh-CN.caption: 平潭站，赛车旁的车手和车队成员。

en.caption: A driver and a team member beside the car in Pingtan.

zh-CN.text: 美术馆又是另一回事。浦东美术馆那支导览片要让人听得懂展览，我也想让大家看到参观者在作品旁边怎么走、在哪儿停。回来剪片，两边都要留。

en.text: The museum was a different job. The guided film needed to explain the exhibition, and I wanted it to show how visitors moved around the work and where they stopped. Both belong in the edit.

zh-CN.caption: 浦东美术馆，参观者在作品旁。

en.caption: Visitors beside the work at the Museum of Art Pudong.

zh-CN.text: RFG Studio 是我们对外用的名字，运营主体是奕曜序（上海）传媒科技有限公司。项目有时我直接跟客户做，也会跟制作团队一起做。专栏就聊这些活，照片怎么选、片子怎么剪，都可以拿实际的项目来说。

en.text: RFG Studio is the name we work under. The business is operated by Yi Yaoxu (Shanghai) Media Technology Co., Ltd. I work directly with clients and also with production teams. This column is where I talk through the work, from choosing photographs to cutting a film.

zh-CN.title: 平潭那天，我在维修区多看了几眼
zh-CN.dek: 2025 年 SRO GT Cup 平潭站，拍莲花车队的四张照片。

en.title: A little longer in the Pingtan garage
en.dek: Four photographs of the Lotus team at the 2025 SRO GT Cup in Pingtan.

zh-CN.text: 2025 年 6 月 28 日，平潭。我去拍莲花车队，车的黄色一进画面就能认出来。这张我更喜欢看车旁边那个人，他身后还有维修区的轮胎和工具。

en.text: June 28, 2025, in Pingtan. I was there to photograph the Lotus team. You spot the yellow car straight away. In this frame I keep looking at the person beside it, with tyres and equipment behind him.

zh-CN.caption: 赛车和维修区里的人。

en.caption: The car and a member of the team in the garage.

zh-CN.text: 头盔搁在车上，车手就站在旁边。这一张离得够近，能看见人是什么状态，画面里也还认得出是哪台车。

en.text: The helmet is on the car and the driver is right beside it. I was close enough to see how he was standing, with enough of the car left to recognise it.

zh-CN.caption: 车手站在车旁，头盔搁在车上。

en.caption: The driver beside the car, with his helmet resting on it.

zh-CN.text: 还有一张我退得比较远。车边的人在忙，后面能看见场地和建筑。放在一起看，我会想起平潭那个地方。

en.text: I stepped farther back for this one. The crew is at work by the car, and you can see the circuit and the buildings behind them. That’s the frame that takes me back to Pingtan.

zh-CN.caption: 从外面看维修区和城市赛道。

en.caption: The pit area and street circuit from farther back.

zh-CN.text: 最后这张我从车窗往里拍。外面那台黄车已经看过了，这里留个近景，看驾驶舱里的车手。

en.text: The last frame looks in through the window. After seeing the yellow car from outside, this gets you close to the driver in the cockpit.

zh-CN.caption: 透过车窗看驾驶舱。

en.caption: Looking through the window into the cockpit.

zh-CN.alt_text: 维修区里，人物和赛车一同进入画面。
zh-CN.caption: 维修区里，人物和赛车一同进入画面。

en.alt_text: A team member and the car share the frame in the garage.
en.caption: A team member and the car share the frame in the garage.

zh-CN.caption: 车手站在维修区入口，头盔放在车顶。

en.caption: A driver at the garage entrance, with his helmet resting on the car.

zh-CN.title: 在浦东美术馆，跟着导览走一遍
zh-CN.dek: 「少儿创艺之城」导览里，讲到的东西得让观众看见。

en.title: Following the guide at the Museum of Art Pudong
en.dek: In the Creative City tour, I wanted viewers to see what the guide was talking about.

zh-CN.text: 浦东美术馆那支导览片，从外景走进展厅。进去以后跟着讲解往前走，讲到一件作品，镜头就给观众一点时间看它。

en.text: The film starts outside the Museum of Art Pudong, then follows the guide into the gallery. When the guide talks about a piece, the cut gives you a moment to look at it.

zh-CN.caption: 「少儿创艺之城」导览画面。

en.caption: A frame from the Creative City exhibition tour.

zh-CN.text: 孩子们搭出来的城市，站着看是整片展台。把镜头放低一点，就能看到不同高度的楼和它们之间空出来的地方。

en.text: From standing height you see the whole display. Drop the camera lower and you can see how tall the little buildings are and what’s between them.

zh-CN.caption: 从展台高度看模型。

en.caption: The model city at display height.

zh-CN.text: 展厅里也有人停下来细看。剪的时候我会把这种画面留一点，让人知道现场是怎么逛的。中英字幕的换行和停留时间也要一起看，别把正在讲的细节盖住。

en.text: People stopped to look more closely, and I wanted some of those moments in the cut. The Chinese and English subtitles needed their own line breaks and timing so they wouldn’t cover the detail being discussed.

zh-CN.caption: 参观者在模型前停下来。

en.caption: Visitors pause by the models.

zh-CN.caption: 从展台高度看孩子们搭出来的城市。

en.alt_text: The children’s model city, seen at display height.
en.caption: The children’s model city, seen at display height.

zh-CN.alt_text: 参观者在模型旁停下来观看。
zh-CN.caption: 参观者在模型旁停下来观看。

en.caption: Visitors pause beside the models.

zh-CN.title: 滴水湖，给跑步的人留一点地方
zh-CN.dek: 2025 年 5 月 2 日清晨，拍人，也把湖边留下来。

en.title: Room to run at Dishui Lake
en.dek: Early on May 2, 2025, I photographed a runner and kept the lake in view.

zh-CN.text: 滴水湖清晨的光很低，人一跑，影子就在路上拉得很长。我喜欢这张竖图里人和影子都在，往下还能看见一段路。

en.text: The light was low at Dishui Lake and the runner cast a long shadow. I like that this vertical frame keeps both the person and the shadow, with some of the path below.

zh-CN.caption: 清晨湖边的跑步人像。

en.caption: An early-morning running portrait by the lake.

zh-CN.text: 再拉开一点，人就只占画面一小块。看得到她往哪儿跑，也看得到那一段空路。

en.text: Pull back and the runner takes up very little of the frame. You can see where she’s headed and the stretch of empty path in front of her.

zh-CN.caption: 留了一段路的远景。

en.caption: A wider frame with room for the path.

zh-CN.text: 最后一张把对岸的楼也留进来了。下次再看，我能一眼认出来是在滴水湖。

en.text: I left the buildings across the water in the last frame. Next time I see it, I’ll know straight away it’s Dishui Lake.

zh-CN.caption: 跑步者、湖岸和对岸的楼。

en.caption: The runner, the shore and the buildings across the lake.

zh-CN.alt_text: 跑步者在画面里只占很小一块，湖边的空地也被保留下来。
zh-CN.caption: 跑步者在画面里只占很小一块，湖边的空地也被保留下来。

en.alt_text: The runner is small in the frame, leaving room for the lakeside setting.
en.caption: The runner is small in the frame, leaving room for the lakeside setting.

zh-CN.alt_text: 湖岸、人物和远处的城市留在同一张照片里。
zh-CN.caption: 湖岸、人物和远处的城市留在同一张照片里。

en.alt_text: Shoreline, runner and distant skyline share the same frame.
en.caption: Shoreline, runner and distant skyline share the same frame.

zh-CN.title: 书院民宿，我喜欢那扇窗
zh-CN.dek: 拍红墙和白浴缸的时候，我把窗外的屋顶也留进来了。

en.title: The window at Shuyuan Guesthouse
en.dek: I kept the rooftops in the frame with the red wall and white bath.

zh-CN.text: 书院民宿这间房，我喜欢从窗边看过去。红墙、白浴缸和黑椅子都在，外面还有树和屋顶。看这张能大概知道，进去以后人会站在哪里。

en.text: I like the view across this room at Shuyuan Guesthouse. There’s the red wall, the white bath and the black chair, with trees and roofs outside. It gives you a feel for where you’d stand in the room.

zh-CN.caption: 窗边的浴缸、椅子和落地灯。

en.caption: The bath, chair and floor lamp by the window.

zh-CN.text: 再靠近浴缸，窗边和地板有一层明暗。我会留住这点差别，也会让窗外能看见一点。广角能交代房间，浴缸离窗多近也值得拍清楚。

en.text: Closer to the bath, you see the change in light from the window to the floor. I wanted to keep that and leave a little of the view outside. The wide shot shows the room. This one shows how close the bath is to the window.

zh-CN.caption: 从浴缸一侧看窗光。

en.caption: Window light from beside the bath.

zh-CN.text: 最后再翻到斗柜那张。先看过房间，这个角落的颜色和东西怎么摆，就有地方可对上。

en.text: Then there’s the chest of drawers. Once you’ve seen the room, you have somewhere to place this corner and the objects in it.

zh-CN.caption: 斗柜和墙上的画。

en.caption: The chest of drawers and the picture above it.

zh-CN.caption: 书院民宿空间摄影 · 影像 04/13

en.caption: Shuyuan Guesthouse Interior Photography · Image 04/13
en.alt_text: Shuyuan Guesthouse Interior Photography, photograph 04

zh-CN.alt_text: 浴缸、红墙和窗边的光都在这个角度里。
zh-CN.caption: 浴缸、红墙和窗边的光都在这个角度里。

en.alt_text: The bath, red wall and window light from one position.
en.caption: The bath, red wall and window light from one position.

zh-CN.alt_text: 从房间全景收回来，单独看斗柜和墙面的细节。
zh-CN.caption: 从房间全景收回来，单独看斗柜和墙面的细节。

en.alt_text: Moving from the room view to the chest of drawers and wall details.
en.caption: Moving from the room view to the chest of drawers and wall details.

zh-CN.title: 花已经很满了，人松一点
zh-CN.dek: 花小念这组，我喜欢那件牛仔服，也喜欢人物坐得很松。

en.title: Let the flowers take up the room
en.dek: I like the denim in this shoot for Huaxiaonian, and how casually she sits.

zh-CN.text: 花小念这束花体量挺大，旁边坐了人，你一下就看得出来。牛仔服也很合适，花那么多颜色，她不用再摆一个很用力的姿势。

en.text: The arrangement for Huaxiaonian is big. You see how big as soon as someone sits next to it. The denim works well. With that much colour in the flowers, she can sit however she likes.

zh-CN.caption: 牛仔服、花材和暖色的房间。

en.caption: Denim, flowers and the warm tones of the room.

zh-CN.text: 靠近一点，有些叶子伸到人物旁边，花的高低也更好看清。竖着拍，下面还留得住花台。

en.text: Closer in, you can see the leaves reaching toward her and the different heights of the flowers. A vertical frame leaves room for the stand too.

zh-CN.caption: 靠近一点看花和人。

en.caption: A closer view of the flowers and the person beside them.

zh-CN.text: 后面有一张她站在花旁边，后面的墙也多了一点。我喜欢把这张跟坐着那张放在一起，同一间房，人的状态不一样。

en.text: In the last frame she stands beside the flowers and you see more of the wall. I like it next to the seated portrait. Same room, different posture.

zh-CN.caption: 人站起来以后，房间也多露出来一点。

en.caption: More of the room comes into view in the standing portrait.

zh-CN.caption: 花小念花艺形象拍摄 · 影像 02/09
zh-CN.alt_text: 花小念花艺形象拍摄现场照片 02

en.caption: Huaxiaonian Floral Brand Portraits · Image 02/09
en.alt_text: Huaxiaonian Floral Brand Portraits, photograph 02

zh-CN.alt_text: 靠近一点，看人物和花材在画面里怎样相接。
zh-CN.caption: 靠近一点，看人物和花材在画面里怎样相接。

en.alt_text: A closer frame shows where the figure and flowers meet.
en.caption: A closer frame shows where the figure and flowers meet.

zh-CN.alt_text: 拉开距离，人物站在花艺旁，室内背景也有了位置。
zh-CN.caption: 拉开距离，人物站在花艺旁，室内背景也有了位置。

en.alt_text: A wider view keeps the standing subject, arrangement and room in frame.
en.caption: A wider view keeps the standing subject, arrangement and room in frame.

zh-CN.title: 一场活动，照片要能让人看明白
zh-CN.dek: 我拍学术活动时，会把讲台、屏幕和听众一起考虑。

en.title: Can you follow the event through the photographs?
en.dek: At a conference I think about the lectern, the screen and the audience together.

zh-CN.text: 上海中医药大学和玉森制药这场，红色屏幕很醒目。我先要一张能看懂会场的照片，讲者、主题和台下的人最好都能找到。

en.text: The red screen stands out at the Shanghai University of Traditional Chinese Medicine and Youseen Pharma event. I wanted a frame that showed how the room was set up, with the speaker, the subject and the audience all easy to find.

zh-CN.caption: 从听众席看开场会场。

en.caption: The opening from the audience seats.

zh-CN.text: 走近一点，手势、表情和讲台上的花都看得见。背景能留一点屏幕，也能看出这一张讲的是哪个环节。

en.text: Moving closer brings in the gesture, expression and flowers on the lectern. A little of the screen helps place the picture in the programme.

zh-CN.caption: 讲者、讲台和屏幕。

en.caption: The speaker, lectern and screen.

zh-CN.text: 会场后面也要走一次。中船动力那组又多了揭牌和技术参观。回来我会按环节排，客户写推文或者做汇报，翻到需要的段落就能拿图。

en.text: I also make a pass at the back of the room. On the CSSC Power job there was an unveiling and a technical tour as well. I order the delivery by what happened so the client can find a picture for a post or a report.

zh-CN.caption: 在会场后方拍听众和投影。

en.caption: Audience and projection from the back of the room.

zh-CN.caption: 上海中医药大学 × 玉森制药学术活动 · 影像 02/07
zh-CN.alt_text: 上海中医药大学 × 玉森制药学术活动现场照片 02

en.caption: Shanghai University of TCM × Yusen Pharma Academic Event · Image 02/07
en.alt_text: Shanghai University of TCM × Yusen Pharma Academic Event, photograph 02

zh-CN.alt_text: 讲者的近景，保留了台上的花艺和屏幕。
zh-CN.caption: 讲者的近景，保留了台上的花艺和屏幕。

en.alt_text: A closer view of the speaker with the lectern flowers and screen.
en.caption: A closer view of the speaker with the lectern flowers and screen.

zh-CN.alt_text: 从会场后方把观众和投影内容放在一起。
zh-CN.caption: 从会场后方把观众和投影内容放在一起。

en.alt_text: The audience and presentation share a frame from the rear of the room.
en.caption: The audience and presentation share a frame from the rear of the room.

zh-CN.title: 合影之外，我还留了几张
zh-CN.dek: 百日宴那组，窗边和床边有些安静的画面。

en.title: A few frames around the family portrait
en.dek: A few quiet frames by the window and the bed at a hundred-day celebration.

zh-CN.text: 窗边这张，妈妈看着镜头，孩子在她怀里看别的地方。她的手还放在孩子身上。我挺喜欢这个样子。

en.text: In the window portrait, the mother looks at the camera and the baby looks elsewhere. Her hand is still resting on the child. I like that moment.

zh-CN.caption: 窗边的妈妈和孩子。

en.caption: Mother and baby by the window.

zh-CN.text: 正式合影拍完，大家还是要照看小孩。有人低下头去看看，这种时候我会顺手留一张。

en.text: After the posed pictures, someone still has to look after the baby. When a parent bends down to check on them, I like to keep a frame.

zh-CN.caption: 在床边低头看孩子。

en.caption: Looking down at the baby by the bed.

zh-CN.text: 两个人站着那张，我第一眼看的是怎么抱孩子。家人以后翻照片，大概也会看见这些平时没太在意的动作。

en.text: In the standing portrait, the first thing I see is how they’re holding the baby. When the family looks through the pictures later, they might notice the little things they hardly thought about at the time.

zh-CN.caption: 父母把孩子抱在中间。

en.caption: The parents hold the baby between them.

zh-CN.caption: 百日宴家庭纪实 · 影像 09/15
zh-CN.alt_text: 百日宴家庭纪实现场照片 09

en.caption: Baby's 100-Day Family Documentary · Image 09/15
en.alt_text: Baby's 100-Day Family Documentary, photograph 09

zh-CN.alt_text: 床边低头照看孩子的一刻。
zh-CN.caption: 床边低头照看孩子的一刻。

en.alt_text: A quiet moment looking down at the baby on the bed.
en.caption: A quiet moment looking down at the baby on the bed.

zh-CN.alt_text: 两个人站在一起，孩子仍被抱在中间。
zh-CN.caption: 两个人站在一起，孩子仍被抱在中间。

zh-CN.title: 浦东美术馆「少儿创艺之城」展览导览视频
zh-CN.summary: 在上海浦东美术馆，以导览、展陈细节与家庭参与为线索完成的一支展览现场视频。
zh-CN.story: 影片从美术馆外景进入展厅，跟随导览讲述儿童共同创作的城市模型、互动提案与现场体验。镜头在空间、作品和参与者之间切换，让信息说明与真实氛围保持平衡。

en.title: A Children’s Creative City — Museum Tour Film
en.summary: An exhibition film made at the Museum of Art Pudong, following the guided tour, installation details and family participation.
en.story: Moving from the museum exterior into the gallery, the film follows a guided account of a city imagined and built by children. Spatial views, artwork details and participant reactions form a clear documentary sequence that balances information with atmosphere.

zh-CN.title: CTCC 2026 鄂尔多斯站｜首日纪实
zh-CN.summary: Richard Shen 在鄂尔多斯国际赛车场拍摄的 CTCC 首日影像，记录维修通道内列队的赛车与主直道上的动态追拍。
zh-CN.story: 从上方俯看维修区的车列，再把视线放回主直道。单车追拍与并行赛车交替，保留了看台、赛道和车速之间的空间感。

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood Café｜前滩太古里开业
zh-CN.summary: 为上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店开业拍摄 Café 空间、品牌标识与陈设细节，记录咖啡吧台及英伦街景主题装置。
zh-CN.story:
这次前滩太古里新店开业拍摄，我把 Vivienne Westwood Café 单独整理成一组。先看咖啡吧台，再看标识、菜单和台面上的用品。把这些放在一起，才看得清这间 Café 的具体样子。

红色电话亭、邮筒和巴士站主题陈设，把英伦街景带进了店内。它们有很强的识别度，但这组照片也留下了吧台本身：咖啡店不只有适合拍照的装置，还有点单、制作和陈列的空间。

这套开业照片里还有店铺空镜和产品静物。我选择把三个主题拆开，让读者能分别看空间、Café 和柜内产品；它们来自同一次拍摄，放回一起也能串起完整的新店记录。

背景资料：前滩太古里的开放式街区，把零售、餐饮与公共空间放在同一条步行路径上。咖啡、陈设与店铺空镜共同记录品牌在日常空间中的呈现。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood Café — Opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan
en.summary: Photography for the opening of Vivienne Westwood at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai, documenting the Café counter, branding, display details and British streetscape installation.
en.story:
For the new-store opening at Taikoo Li Qiantan, I have given the Vivienne Westwood Café its own series. The sequence starts with the counter, then moves to signage, menus and counter accessories. Together, these views describe the Café at different scales.

A red telephone box, postbox and bus-stop installation bring a British street setting into the store. They are distinctive elements, but the counter remains part of the story too: the Café is also a space arranged around ordering, preparation and display.

The same shoot includes retail interiors and product still lifes. I have separated the three subjects so each can be viewed in its own right. Read together, they make a fuller record of the new store.

Background: Taikoo Li Qiantan brings retail, dining and public space together in an open-air precinct. The café, displays and store interiors document the brand within an everyday setting.

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood｜前滩太古里店铺空镜
zh-CN.summary: 为上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店拍摄店铺空镜，以门头、室内全景、休息区与陈列细节呈现零售空间。
zh-CN.story:
这一篇接着前滩 Café，往店铺里面走。门头交代入口，室内全景交代柜台、通道和陈列的位置。我把这些画面留在一组里，方便先理解空间，再看里面的东西。

弧形展示柜、镜面墙体和沙发休息区，是这套空镜里的几个重点。镜面会把陈列和空间重复带进画面，柜台的弧线又改变了观看方向。全景和局部各有用途，不能只用一种距离看完整间店。

服装、包袋、眼镜、围巾和腰带都在各自的陈列位置上。这篇保留它们与店铺的关系，珠宝和腕表则另放进产品篇。这样看空镜的时候，视线不会总被某一件产品带走。

背景资料：前滩太古里的开放式街区，把零售、餐饮与公共空间放在同一条步行路径上。咖啡、陈设与店铺空镜共同记录品牌在日常空间中的呈现。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood — Store Interiors at Taikoo Li Qiantan
en.summary: Retail space photography of the new Vivienne Westwood store at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai, covering the storefront, interior views, seating area and merchandise displays.
en.story:
This series continues beyond the Qiantan Café into the retail space. The storefront establishes the entrance; wider interior views show the counters, circulation and displays. I have kept these photographs together so the layout can be understood before its details.

Curved display counters, mirrored walls and the seating area are key parts of the series. Mirrors repeat the displays and the room, while the curves of the counters change the viewing direction. Wider frames and closer details describe different aspects of the interior.

Clothing, bags, eyewear, scarves and belts appear in their display settings. This article keeps those relationships with the room intact, while jewellery and watches receive a separate product story.

Background: Taikoo Li Qiantan brings retail, dining and public space together in an open-air precinct. The café, displays and store interiors document the brand within an everyday setting.

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood｜珠宝与腕表静物摄影
zh-CN.summary: 在上海前滩太古里 Vivienne Westwood 新店开业拍摄中，以柜内静物和局部特写记录珠宝、珍珠饰品与腕表的陈列细节。
zh-CN.story:
前滩新店开业的第三个主题，是珠宝与腕表。这组是在现场展示柜里完成的静物摄影。我把组合陈列、俯拍和单件特写放在一起，既交代产品的排列，也留下每件东西的细节。

Orb 标识、珍珠饰品、表盘和金属表带，各自需要不同的观看距离。整柜画面能看出系列，近一点才看得见标识、轮廓和材质。玻璃反射与柜内灯光也留在照片里，说明它们当时是怎样被展示的。

我把它单列为产品篇，是因为看产品和看店铺的重点确实不同。这里不需要把整间店重新讲一遍，注意力就放在这些小物件，以及它们在柜台里形成的组合上。

背景资料：Westwood 的 Orb 标志把王权宝球与土星环结合，延续品牌将传统带向未来的想法。标志、珠宝与装饰细节，是这组影像中反复出现的视觉线索。

en.title: Vivienne Westwood — Jewellery and Watch Still Life
en.summary: Still-life and detail photography of jewellery, pearl accessories and watches, photographed in display cases for the opening of Vivienne Westwood at Taikoo Li Qiantan in Shanghai.
en.story:
Jewellery and watches form the third part of the Qiantan store-opening shoot. These still lifes were photographed in the display cases. Collection views, overhead compositions and individual close-ups show both the arrangements and the details of each piece.

Orb motifs, pearl accessories, watch dials and metal bracelets invite different viewing distances. Collection frames describe the range; closer photographs reveal the motifs, shapes and materials. Glass reflections and display lighting retain the context of the store.

I have made this a separate product story because its focus differs from the interior series. The attention here stays with the small objects and the combinations they form inside the cases.

Background: Westwood’s Orb combines a royal orb with a Saturn-like ring, reflecting the house’s idea of taking tradition into the future. Emblems, jewellery and decorative details recur throughout this series.

zh-CN.title: Gerald Charles｜招商银行私人银行制表文化讲座
zh-CN.summary: 与美时维工坊合作，在招商银行私人银行举办制表文化系列讲座，围绕 Gerald Charles 的品牌历史与制表知识展开分享，记录讲座现场、腕表展示和陈设细节。
zh-CN.story:
这次与美时维工坊合作，在招商银行私人银行举办制表文化系列讲座。内容围绕 Gerald Charles 的品牌历史与制表知识展开，我记录了讲者、听众、腕表展示和现场陈设。

在这组照片里，讲座和产品展示是连着的。讲者与听众的画面交代交流，展示桌、表盘和多色表带则把讲座涉及的对象具体呈现出来。只有会场全景，或者只有腕表特写，都不足以说明这次活动。

专栏里我把这两条线交替放在一起。读者可以先看人在讲什么样的活动，再靠近看腕表；这里记录的是讲座与展示现场，不把它写成没有依据的产品评测。

背景资料：Gerald Charles 由 Gérald Charles Genta 于 2000 年创立。以设计师原始草图为延续的品牌脉络，为这场制表文化讲座提供了清晰的设计背景。
services: 腕表展示及陈设细节摄影
zh-CN.background: Gerald Charles 由 Gérald Charles Genta 于 2000 年创立。以设计师原始草图为延续的品牌脉络，为这场制表文化讲座提供了清晰的设计背景。

en.title: Gerald Charles — Watchmaking Culture Lecture at China Merchants Bank Private Banking
en.summary: A watchmaking culture lecture jointly organised with Meishiwei Workshop at China Merchants Bank Private Banking, exploring Gerald Charles brand history and watchmaking through lecture coverage, watch displays and event details.
en.story:
This watchmaking-culture lecture was organised with Treasure Care at China Merchants Bank Private Banking. The programme covered Gerald Charles brand history and watchmaking knowledge; my photographs document the speakers, audience, watches and display setting.

The lecture and the product displays belong to the same record. Speaker and audience photographs show the exchange, while tables, dials and coloured straps give the discussion a visible subject. Neither venue views nor watch close-ups alone describe the whole event.

I have interwoven those two strands here, moving from the lecture setting to closer views of the watches. This is a record of the event and its displays, rather than a product review.

Background: Founded by Gérald Charles Genta in 2000, Gerald Charles continues a design lineage rooted in his original drawings. That history provides context for this watchmaking-culture lecture.
services: Watch display and event detail photography

zh-CN.title: Brand SA｜上海浦东丽晶酒店南非社群交流活动
zh-CN.summary: 在上海浦东丽晶酒店记录与 Brand SA 合作的南非社群交流活动，涵盖现场布置、嘉宾发言、证书颁授、来宾交流与合影。
zh-CN.story:
这次在上海浦东丽晶酒店，记录与 Brand SA 合作的南非社群交流活动。Global South Africans Network 的现场展示、嘉宾发言、证书颁授和来宾合影，构成了这组照片的主要内容。

正式环节之外，还有来宾之间的交流。人物特写和合影会给出不同的信息：一张看表情与手势，另一张看谁和谁站在一起。整理这组照片时，我把空间、流程和交流画面都留了下来。

这场拍摄启用了索尼 FE 50–150mm F2 GM，整理的十张照片中有六张以这支镜头的 F2 光圈拍摄。照片里的前后景层次可以直接看，器材信息放在这里作为这次拍摄的记录，不替代对现场的描述。

背景资料：Brand South Africa 通过 Global South Africans 等倡议连接海外南非社群。在上海的交流现场，人物之间的距离与谈话构成画面的主要线索。

en.title: Brand SA — South African Community Gathering at Regent Shanghai Pudong
en.summary: Photography of a South African community gathering in collaboration with Brand SA at Regent Shanghai Pudong, covering the venue setup, speeches, certificate presentations, guest conversations and group portraits.
en.story:
At Regent Shanghai Pudong, I documented a South African community gathering in collaboration with Brand SA. Global South Africans Network displays, speeches, certificate presentations and group portraits form the main record.

Conversations among guests sit alongside the formal programme. Close portraits describe expressions and gestures; group photographs show people together. The selection keeps the venue, event sequence and exchanges in view.

This shoot introduced the Sony FE 50–150mm F2 GM into my setup. Six of the ten selected photographs were made with that lens at F2. Foreground and background separation can be seen in the images; the equipment detail is part of the shoot record, not a substitute for it.

Background: Brand South Africa connects South Africans abroad through initiatives including Global South Africans. At the Shanghai gathering, conversations and the relationships between people become the series’ central visual thread.

zh-CN.summary: 受邀记录厦门爱歌合唱团在东方艺术中心的演出，精选舞台全景、成员神态、现场发言、合唱团与观众的星光合照，以及后台成员肖像与合影。
zh-CN.story:
受厦门爱歌合唱团邀请，我在东方艺术中心记录了这次演出。舞台全景里有合唱团、指挥和钢琴伴奏，靠近一些的画面则留下成员的神态与动作。两种距离一起看，演出才不只是一排站在台上的人。

我把合唱团与观众共同参与的星光合照放在开头。它能直接交代舞台和观众的关系，再往后看演唱、发言和人物细节，就知道这些画面属于同一个现场。

后台花絮也一起收进来了：走廊中的个人肖像、双人合影，和台上的正式画面有不同的状态。我希望这篇既能看到演出，也能看到演出之外的团员，而不是把后台另外当成几张随手的补充。

背景资料：东方艺术中心由保罗·安德鲁设计，建筑形态如蝴蝶兰。这里的记录从舞台延伸到后台，保留合唱演出中集体与个人的两种尺度。

en.title: Xiamen Aige Choir — Performance at Shanghai Oriental Art Center
en.summary: An invited photographic record of Xiamen Aige Choir at Shanghai Oriental Art Center, featuring stage views, choir members, an on-stage address and a starlight group photograph with the audience, plus backstage portraits and paired photographs.
en.story:
Invited by Xiamen Aige Choir, I photographed the performance at Shanghai Oriental Art Center. Wider stage views show the choir, conductor and piano accompaniment; closer frames record expressions and gestures. The two distances describe the performance together.

I have opened with the starlight group photograph involving the choir and audience. It establishes their relationship before the singing, speaking and closer portraits are seen as parts of the same occasion.

Backstage photographs are included too: individual portraits and paired photographs in the corridor offer a different view from the stage. They give the choir members a place in the story beyond the formal performance.

Background: Designed by Paul Andreu, the Oriental Art Center has an orchid-like form. This series extends from stage to backstage, retaining both the ensemble and individual perspectives of a choral performance.
services: Starlight group photograph with the audience
highlights: Performance coverage under strict venue requirements
Starlight group photograph with performers and audience

zh-CN.title: 上海 Te Amo 三十岁生日聚会
zh-CN.summary: 以强烈的红色空间为视觉基调，记录三十岁生日聚会的个人肖像、朋友互动、空间布置与集体合影。
zh-CN.story:
上海 Te Amo 的这场三十岁生日聚会，有一个非常鲜明的红色空间。个人肖像、朋友互动、现场布置和集体合影，都围绕这个空间展开，它也是这一组照片最直接的视觉线索。

我把派对中热闹的画面和相对安静的肖像一起留下。空间颜色很强，人物之间的交流也需要被看见；照片里既有聚会的样子，也有属于生日主角的单独时刻。

私人活动的故事不需要替主角补写人生感悟。三十岁这一天的朋友、布置和人物状态，就可以构成一份具体的纪念。

en.title: 30th Birthday Celebration at Te Amo, Shanghai
en.summary: Set within a vivid red interior, this series documents personal portraits, friendships, styling details and group moments at a 30th birthday celebration.
en.story:
The thirtieth-birthday gathering at Te Amo in Shanghai took place in a vivid red interior. Portraits, friends, decorations and group photographs share that setting, which gives the series its clearest visual thread.

I have kept energetic party frames alongside quieter portraits. The strong colour belongs to the setting, while exchanges among friends and individual portraits give people their own place within it.

A personal celebration does not need an invented life reflection. The friends, decorations and portraits from that day make a specific record of the birthday.

zh-CN.title: SRO GT Cup 2025 福建平潭站｜莲花车队纪实
zh-CN.summary: 以赛道与维修区为叙事场景，记录莲花赛车、车手及团队在 SRO GT Cup 平潭站的工作状态与现场氛围。
zh-CN.story:
本组作品从赛道、维修区与车队工作现场展开，在速度之外关注车手、工程师与车辆之间的协作关系。画面同时保留赛事的紧张节奏、品牌识别与平潭城市赛道的空间特征，形成一组兼具纪实性与商业传播价值的赛车影像。

背景资料：2025 年 SRO GT 杯平潭站于 6 月 28 至 29 日举行。如意湖赛道将城市道路与专用赛段结合，滨海城市也成为赛车影像的一部分。

en.summary: A trackside and pit-lane documentary following Lotus race cars, drivers and crew during the Pingtan round of the SRO GT Cup.
en.story:
Moving between the circuit, pit lane and team workspace, this series looks beyond speed to the working relationship between drivers, engineers and cars. The images retain the tension of race day, clear brand presence and the distinctive setting of Pingtan's city circuit, creating a motorsport story suited to both documentary and commercial use.

Background: The 2025 SRO GT Cup visited Pingtan on 28-29 June. Ruyi Lake combines public roads with purpose-built track sections, bringing the coastal city into the racing photographs.

zh-CN.title: 一尺花园戏剧疗愈活动
zh-CN.summary: 记录戏剧疗愈活动中的引导、互动、练习与合影，呈现参与者之间自然、开放的交流状态。
zh-CN.story:
这一组记录一尺花园的戏剧疗愈活动。照片跟随引导、练习、互动和分享展开，人物的表情、肢体动作以及大家站在一起的关系，是比单张合影更多的内容。

我把练习过程放在专栏的中心。近一点看个人反应，远一点看群体怎样互动，两种画面可以帮助读者理解活动形式，而不是只知道“这里办过一次活动”。

这里不根据一张表情判断参与者的心理，也不替活动写疗效结论。影像保留的是当时看得见的交流和动作，合影则作为这次相聚的另一种记录。

背景资料：一尺花园把咖啡、西餐与活动场地放在生活艺术空间中。戏剧活动把动作、表情与参与者之间的互动带进这一日常场景。

en.title: Yichi Garden Drama Therapy Workshop
en.summary: A documentary of facilitation, exercises, interaction and group portraits, capturing an open and natural exchange between participants.
en.story:
This series documents a drama-therapy workshop at Yichi Huayuan. It follows facilitation, exercises, interaction and sharing, with attention to expressions, movement and how participants appear together.

I have put the exercises at the centre of the story. Closer frames show individual responses; wider photographs describe group interaction and make the form of the workshop visible.

The photographs do not diagnose anyone’s feelings or make claims about therapeutic outcomes. They record visible exchanges and gestures, with group portraits as another part of the gathering.

Background: Yichi Garden combines coffee, dining and event facilities in its lifestyle spaces. The drama session brings gestures, expressions and interactions between participants into this everyday setting.

zh-CN.title: 宝格丽上海露台求婚纪实
zh-CN.summary: 在温暖、私密的聚会氛围中记录求婚现场、亲友互动与情绪瞬间。
zh-CN.story:
这组私人求婚纪实在上海宝格丽的露台拍摄。求婚前后的准备、反应、拥抱和亲友互动，是照片里的主要内容。它属于人物与私人纪实这一组，记录的是主角与亲友的相聚。

露台与自然光交代了环境，人物画面则把注意力带到事件本身。我把关键瞬间和前后的照片放在一起，让求婚不是只有一个单独被截下来的动作。

这些照片里的亲友也值得留下。看他们的反应，再看两位主角，能让这篇保留一场私人相聚的完整关系，而不只是两个人面对镜头的合影。

en.title: Proposal at Bvlgari Shanghai Terrace
en.summary: An intimate, warmly lit documentary of a proposal celebration, preserving the reactions and interactions shared with family and friends.
en.story:
This private proposal was photographed on the terrace at Bulgari in Shanghai. The series covers preparation, reactions, embraces and exchanges with family and friends, as part of my personal documentary work.

The terrace and natural light establish the environment, while the people carry the occasion. I have kept the decisive moment alongside photographs from before and after it.

Family and friends belong in the record too. Their responses place the couple within the gathering rather than limiting the story to posed portraits of two people.

zh-CN.title: 中船动力企业活动纪实
zh-CN.summary: 完整记录企业揭牌、培训分享、技术参观、嘉宾交流与集体合影等关键环节。
zh-CN.story:
中船动力这组企业活动，有揭牌、培训分享、技术参观、嘉宾交流和集体合影。我沿着这些环节完成拍摄，让一组照片能够清楚交代当天做了哪些事。

正式环节需要交代人物与现场，交流画面则能看到参与者之间的关系。空间细节也值得保留：它们说明事情发生在哪里，不能让所有照片只剩下单独的人像。

我把这篇按流程整理，而不是把最好看的几张随机摆在一起。翻完之后，读者应该可以分清揭牌、分享和参观各自的画面，这也是企业活动记录很实际的一部分。

背景资料：中船动力的业务涵盖船用动力研发、制造与服务。企业活动影像把目光转向这一工业体系中的人：发言、交流与团队同框。

en.title: CSSC Power Corporate Event Documentary
en.summary: Comprehensive coverage of an unveiling ceremony, training sessions, technical visits, guest exchanges and formal group portraits.
en.story:
The CSSC Power event included an unveiling, training, technical visits, guest conversations and group photographs. My coverage follows those stages to make the programme readable as a photographic record.

Formal stages establish people and setting; conversation photographs show participants in relation to one another. Environmental details also explain where the activities took place.

I have organised the story by its sequence rather than placing individual favourites in a random order. The unveiling, presentations and visits remain identifiable as distinct parts of the event.

Background: CSSC Marine Power works across marine-engine research, manufacturing and services. The event photographs turn towards the people in that industrial system: speaking, exchanging ideas and appearing together.

zh-CN.title: 惠普 OMEN 人物定妆照
zh-CN.summary: 为项目成员拍摄统一视觉语言的人物定妆照，保留自然姿态与清晰的品牌环境信息。
zh-CN.story:
这组是惠普 OMEN 项目成员的定妆照。背景、光线和构图保持统一，让它们放在一起时是一套完整的人物照片；每个人的姿态和个体特征，又需要在这套统一画面里被看见。

品牌环境提供了清楚的背景信息，但人物仍是照片的重点。我把不同成员的肖像并列展示，方便看见这组拍摄的统一性，也方便比较其中自然的变化。

定妆照并不需要每个人做完全一样的表情。对这篇来说，同一套视觉条件下出现的不同状态，比再添加一段笼统的品牌介绍更有用。

These are cast portraits for an HP OMEN project. A consistent background, lighting setup and composition make them a coherent set while retaining each person’s posture and individual features.

The brand setting supplies context, while the people remain the focus. I have presented the portraits alongside one another so both their consistency and differences are visible.

A consistent portrait series does not require identical expressions. The different states visible within the same visual conditions are the subject of this story.

zh-CN.title: 儿童十岁生日宴
zh-CN.summary: 记录一场儿童十岁生日宴中的人物肖像、亲友互动、蛋糕与气球布置，以及窗边夜景下的庆祝片段。
zh-CN.story:
这一组儿童十岁生日宴照片，围绕生日主角和现场亲友展开。正式肖像、蛋糕前的庆祝和窗边的自然片段放在一起，让主角在不同环节里的样子都能被留下。

气球、花艺和成长照片展板，补上了这场生日宴的具体细节。它们和人物照片并列时，能看出这是一场怎样被布置的生日，而不是任何一次都可以套用的庆祝背景。

我把窗边的片段也留进了这篇。看蛋糕、看合影，再看到这些较自然的画面，这一天的记录会多一些停顿，人物也不必每一张都在正式看镜头。

en.title: A Child’s Tenth Birthday Celebration
en.summary: Portraits, interactions among guests, cake and balloon decorations, and moments of celebration beside a night-time city view at a child’s tenth birthday party.
en.story:
This tenth-birthday series follows the birthday child and family and friends. Formal portraits, the celebration beside the cake and candid moments by the window preserve different parts of the occasion.

Balloons, flowers and a display of childhood photographs add specific details. Alongside the portraits, they describe the setting of this particular celebration.

I have kept the window-side moments too. They provide pauses beside the cake and group portraits, allowing the people to appear without always facing the camera formally.

zh-CN.title: 山路之间｜四明山驾驶纪实
zh-CN.summary: 在宁波四明山，以随车动态摄影、驾驶者肖像与沿途停驻，记录 Lotus 跑车、Toyota GR Yaris 与 Porsche 911 Carrera GTS 敞篷共同展开的一段山路旅程。
zh-CN.story:
这组在宁波四明山完成，记录 Lotus 跑车、Toyota GR Yaris 和 Porsche 911 Carrera GTS 敞篷的山路行程，车手刘瑞琦也参与了这次出行。照片从集结进入山路，再回到座舱和途中停驻。

连续弯道和林间光影，是这段行程本身带来的背景。随车动态画面里，车身轮廓和流动的环境同时存在；驾驶者的肖像则把画面带回车里，让人和车都留在这套记录中。

我没有把停驻的片刻拿掉。把它们放在驾驶画面旁边，能让这组照片保留一次真实出行的顺序，而不只是几辆车在山路上的单张图片。

背景资料：四明山腹地的森林与高山环境，构成宁波山地风景的一部分。这组驾驶影像关注车辆与沿途环境的关系，也保留行程中停下来观看风景的片刻。

seo.description: RFG Studio 在宁波四明山，以随车动态摄影与驾驶者肖像记录汽车、人物与山路风景。

zh-CN.background: 四明山腹地的森林与高山环境，构成宁波山地风景的一部分。这组驾驶影像关注车辆与沿途环境的关系，也保留行程中停下来观看风景的片刻。

en.title: Between the Bends — A Siming Mountain Drive
en.summary: An automotive photo story in Ningbo’s Siming Mountains, following Lotus sports cars, a Toyota GR Yaris and a Porsche 911 Carrera GTS Cabriolet through rolling shots, driver portraits and stops along the way.
en.story:
Photographed in Siming Mountain, Ningbo, this series follows Lotus sports cars, a Toyota GR Yaris and a Porsche 911 Carrera GTS Cabriolet. Racing driver Liu Ruiqi joined the outing. The photographs move from the gathering to the road, cockpit and stops along the way.

Winding roads and light through the trees form the setting of the journey. Moving photographs keep the cars and landscape together, while driver portraits return the sequence to the cockpit.

I have kept the quieter stops alongside the driving frames. They preserve the sequence of an outing rather than turning it into isolated pictures of cars on a mountain road.

Background: Forests and upland terrain form part of Ningbo’s Siming Mountain landscape. This driving series follows cars in their surroundings and the pauses along the journey.

zh-CN.title: 弯道节奏｜天马赛车场赛道日
zh-CN.summary: 在上海天马国际赛车场，以动态追焦与维修区静态摄影，记录赛道日中车辆的行进姿态与驾驶之间的片刻。
zh-CN.story:
上海天马国际赛车场这组赛道日照片，有直道、弯道，也有维修区。动态追焦留住车身轮廓与流动的背景，静态画面再补上车辆细节和现场环境。

同一辆车，行驶和停下来的观看重点不一样。动态照片里先看姿态，停驻时可以看车身局部。把两种画面排在一起，是为了让这一天的驾驶和间歇都出现在记录里。

这次是赛道日纪实，没有必要把它写成比赛结果。我想留下的是车辆在这条赛道上的样子，以及驾驶活动周围那些也值得看的片刻。

背景资料：天马赛车场自 2004 年运营，兼具赛事、驾驶培训与汽车文化活动功能。赛道日的记录，在车辆动态之外，也留意维修区与等待上场的间隙。

en.title: Circuit Rhythm — A Track Day at Tianma
en.summary: A track-day photo series at Shanghai Tianma International Circuit, combining on-track panning with still photographs in the pit area.
en.story:
This track-day series at Shanghai Tianma Circuit includes straights, corners and the pit area. Panning photographs place the cars against moving backgrounds; static frames add vehicle details and the setting around them.

The same car offers different things to see in motion and at rest. Driving frames describe its stance; parked views allow its details to be examined. Together they retain both driving and intervals from the day.

This is a track-day record, not a report of race results. The photographs stay with the cars on this circuit and the moments surrounding the driving.

Background: Operating since 2004, Tianma Circuit hosts racing, driver training and automotive activities. This track-day coverage also attends to the pits and the intervals before cars return to the circuit.

zh-CN.title: 莲花 For Me / Eletre X｜国际媒体试驾影像
zh-CN.summary: 为莲花 For Me / Eletre X 国际媒体试驾提供全程平面记录，涵盖产品技术分享、媒体交流、车辆静态与动态拍摄，以及海外媒体图片支持与现场协调。
zh-CN.story:
这次莲花 For Me / Eletre X 国际媒体试驾，我负责全程平面记录，也配合海外媒体的图片需求与现场拍摄协调。车辆静态、动态试驾、车评人肖像和现场交流，都在这次拍摄的范围里。

媒体试驾的照片要能分别回答几件具体的事：车是什么样，驾驶发生在怎样的环境里，媒体人物又处在什么状态。整理时我把这些内容放进同一套记录，而不是只留下几张整车照片。

与英国汽车评论人士和海外媒体团队的协作，还包括拍摄安排、图片需求与素材交付。我把人物与车辆的画面一起整理，让不同的报道需求能在同一套素材里找到对应的图片。

室内交流是这次试驾记录的另一部分。Chong Yok Meng 面向国际媒体进行 Product Deep Dive 产品技术分享，现场屏幕还展示了羌塘无人区的测试资料。这组照片补充了讲述者、聆听的媒体嘉宾与完整会场，让车辆之外的交流过程也得到保留。

官方产品背景：For Me 是莲花首款插电式混合动力车型，采用 900V X-Hybrid 架构，在欧洲称为 Eletre X。这些信息用于说明项目背景，不作为当天发言的逐字记录。

内饰补充以完整座舱、前排座椅和操作细节三条线索展开。不同配色各有保留，近似机位在作品集内择优展示；原片全部保存在同一项目中。仪表及中控屏的显示数值仅作为现场画面，不被引用为车辆性能或续航结论。

媒体沟通与现场拍摄协调
highlights: 产品技术分享与媒体交流

en.title: Lotus For Me / Eletre X — International Media Drive Photography
en.summary: Full-event photography for the Lotus For Me / Eletre X international media drive, covering the product technical briefing, media exchanges, static and driving images, editorial image support and on-site coordination.
en.story:
For the Lotus For Me / Eletre X international media drive, I provided still photography throughout the event, supported overseas media image requirements and coordinated shooting on site. The coverage includes static cars, driving images, reviewer portraits and exchanges during the programme.

The images need to show the vehicle, the setting of the drive and the people making the coverage. I have kept those subjects within one sequence rather than reducing the record to full-car photographs.

Working with British automotive reviewers and international media teams also involved shooting arrangements, image requirements and delivery. Keeping people and vehicles in the same photographic record gives different editorial needs their corresponding images.

The indoor session forms another part of this media-drive record. Chong Yok Meng delivered a Product Deep Dive to international media, with Changtang testing material visible on the presentation screens. The additional photographs show the speaker, media attendees and the wider room, extending the coverage beyond the car to the exchange around it.

Official product background: For Me is the first Lotus plug-in hybrid model, built on the 900V X-Hybrid architecture and named Eletre X in Europe. This provides project context; it is not a transcript of the briefing.

The interior supplement follows three strands: complete cockpits, front seats and control details. Each colourway is represented, with similar viewpoints curated for the portfolio while all originals remain in this project. Displayed instrument and infotainment numbers are treated as photographed content, not performance or range claims.
services: Editorial image delivery for international media
Media communication and on-site shoot coordination
highlights: Product technical briefing and media exchanges

zh-CN.title: 弦间光影｜西音录音棚大提琴演奏会
zh-CN.summary: 在上海西音音乐录音棚，以演奏者肖像、钢琴伴奏与观众视角，记录一场大提琴演奏会的现场。
zh-CN.story:
这场大提琴演奏会在上海西音音乐录音棚举行。木质空间、琴身和温暖的现场灯光都留在画面里，人物近景则记录演奏者的专注与弓弦动作。

演奏者的单人画面之外，我也把钢琴和大提琴同台的照片留了下来。不同乐器在同一个空间里，观众视角又补上了观看的距离。这样整理，比只看演奏者的特写更能理解现场。

这套演出影像没有用很大的叙事去包裹它。一个录音棚、一场演奏、人物与乐器之间的动作，就已经是这一篇值得仔细看的内容。

en.summary: A photographic record of a cello recital at Xiyin Music Recording Studio in Shanghai, bringing together performer portraits, piano accompaniment and views from the audience.
en.story:
This cello recital took place at Xiyin recording studio in Shanghai. The wooden interior, instruments and warm lighting remain in the frames, with closer photographs recording concentration and bow movement.

Alongside individual portraits, the series includes cello and piano sharing the space. Perspectives from the audience add the distance of listening, giving the recital more context than close-ups alone.

This story stays close to what was photographed: a recital in a recording studio, and the gestures connecting performers with their instruments.

zh-CN.title: 相伴此刻｜上海中环婚礼纪实
zh-CN.summary: 在上海中环，以新人肖像、婚车旁的亲密互动与亲友交流，记录婚礼中的温柔瞬间。
zh-CN.story:
上海中环这组婚礼纪实，从车窗里的新娘肖像，看到新人相吻、举起捧花和亲友交流。婚车不只是背景，车窗和车身倒影也参与了画面的构图。

白色婚纱、粉色花束和自然光，让这些照片有了柔和的层次。比起单独强调礼服或花束，我更愿意把它们和人物的动作一起看：照片的内容仍然是新人之间，以及新人和亲友之间的关系。

这一篇保留的是婚礼中的一段，不把没有覆盖到的仪式流程补写进来。车旁的亲密互动和俯身交流，已经能具体说明这一组影像记录了什么。

en.title: Together in the Moment — A Wedding in Shanghai's Zhonghuan Area
en.summary: Couple portraits, intimate moments beside the wedding car and exchanges with loved ones from a wedding in Shanghai's Zhonghuan area.
en.story:
This wedding series in Zhonghuan, Shanghai, moves from a bridal portrait in the car window to a kiss, a raised bouquet and exchanges with loved ones. Windows and reflections make the car part of the framing as well as the setting.

A white gown, pink flowers and natural light give the frames a gentle palette. I have kept these details in relation to gestures between the couple and with family and friends.

This article describes a portion of the wedding rather than adding an unrecorded ceremony. The close interactions beside the car are the specific subject of the series.

zh-CN.story:
2025 梦百合 × 曼联 0压嘉年华上海站，在红星美凯龙上海汶水商场举行。我记录了安迪·科尔到场后的球迷互动、球衣签名、舞台合影，以及商场中庭的活动空间。

全景里能看到红蓝色的布置和人群，靠近之后则是球衣、动作和笑容。两种距离串起来，品牌现场和球迷相聚就不会被拆成互不相关的两套照片。

这一篇保留互动环节的照片，而不只挑嘉宾面对镜头的那几张。签名和合影本身就是当天的重要内容，球迷也应该在这套记录里有自己的位置。

zh-CN.title: 路特斯 Evija｜上海展出社交媒体影像
zh-CN.summary: 为路特斯 Evija 在上海展出拍摄一组社交媒体照片，以整车构图与细节特写呈现黑金车身的线条、材质与光影。
zh-CN.story:
这组为路特斯 Evija 在上海展出拍摄的社交媒体照片，以静态画面为主。整车构图先交代姿态，轮毂、后视镜和车身标识的特写，再把注意力带到具体的部位。

现场网格灯光映在黑色车身上，和金色饰线一起勾出曲面的变化。同一个反射，远看是整车的线条，近看又成为材质与表面的一部分。这也是整车与细节值得同时保留的原因。

这篇就专心看一辆展车。没有驾驶片段，也不加入没有拍到的性能叙事，留下现场的空间、车身和光线之间可以直接看到的关系。

背景资料：Evija 的碳纤维车身与后部文丘里通道，将空气动力学直接写进造型。这里的静态影像关注曲面、开口与展陈灯光之间的关系。

en.title: Lotus Evija — Shanghai Social Media Photography
en.summary: A series of social media photographs created for the Lotus Evija's display in Shanghai, combining full-car compositions with close-ups of its black-and-gold finish, materials and reflections.
en.story:
These social-media photographs document the Lotus Evija on display in Shanghai. Full-car compositions establish its stance, followed by closer views of the wheels, mirrors and body lettering.

The lighting grid reflects across the black bodywork and meets the gold accents. Seen from farther away, the reflections trace the car; closer views make them part of the surface and material. Both scales have a place in the series.

This story stays with a single display car. It does not add a driving narrative or performance claims; it shows the visible relationship between the setting, bodywork and light.

Background: Evija integrates aerodynamics into its carbon-fibre body and rear Venturi tunnels. These photographs study the relationship between surfaces, openings and exhibition lighting.

zh-CN.title: Vivienne Westwood｜中信泰富圣诞活动
zh-CN.summary: 为 Vivienne Westwood 在中信泰富商场举办的圣诞活动提供摄影，记录节日装置、现场绘画互动与人物肖像，呈现品牌空间中的节日氛围。
zh-CN.story:
这次为 Vivienne Westwood 在中信泰富商场举办的圣诞活动拍摄。室外圣诞树上的品牌标识与装饰，是这组照片的起点；走进店里，内容变成绘画互动、饮品制作和来宾肖像。

绘画过程和拿着画作的肖像，能把互动前后连起来。调饮的动作、展示柜与人物也在同一个空间里，它们交代的是这场活动的具体内容，不只是一个圣诞装饰背景。

我把室外与室内都留下，让人能从商场的节日装置一路看到店内体验。这次的摄影记录包含空间，也包含实际发生在空间里的人和事。

背景资料：Westwood 的 Orb 标志把王权宝球与土星环结合，延续品牌将传统带向未来的想法。标志、珠宝与装饰细节，是这组影像中反复出现的视觉线索。

zh-CN.story:

en.title: Meishiwei Workshop — DIY Watchmaking Training Coverage
en.summary: Full-session video coverage and photography for a DIY watchmaking training project at Meishiwei Workshop, documenting hands-on practice, instruction and the use of precision tools.
en.story:
I photographed and filmed the full DIY watchmaking training at Treasure Care, part of Melchers. The coverage follows instruction, participant exercises and the use of tools and components at the workbench.

Portraits show the concentration of the participants; close-ups explain their hand movements. Tools, dials and small components share the frame so the activity can be understood in relation to the workbench.

The record also includes finished-piece presentations and group photographs. I have kept the process in this training story and the completed pieces in a separate still-life series. Video preserves continuity, while photographs allow the details to be examined.

events.title: 美时维工坊｜钟表 DIY 培训影像
events.summary: 为美最时洋行旗下美时维工坊的钟表 DIY 培训提供全程视频拍摄与摄影，记录教学指导、工具使用与动手操作的细节。

zh-CN.title: 美时维工坊｜钟表 DIY 成品静物摄影
zh-CN.summary: 为美时维工坊钟表 DIY 项目的成品拍摄静物照片，以系列陈列与局部特写呈现表盘色彩、图案纹理和金属表壳细节。
zh-CN.story:
这组是钟表 DIY 项目完成后的成品摄影。和培训时的照片不同，画面里不再以教学过程为主角，而是让已经做出来的作品被单独看见。

灰色展示托盘把各只表分开，也衬出了表盘的颜色和图案。系列全景可以比较不同作品，单件特写则看指针、表壳和表盘纹理。这两种照片放在一起，比只挑一张好看的产品图更能说明这一组作品。

我把这组从培训记录中拆出来，是想保留成品自己的观看节奏。读完前面的工作台故事，再看这些表，也能对应上从零件到完整外观的变化。
services: 产品细节与系列陈列摄影

seo.title: 钟表 DIY 成品静物摄影｜RFG Studio
seo.description: 美时维工坊钟表 DIY 成品静物摄影，以系列陈列和单件特写呈现表盘色彩、图案及表壳细节。

en.title: Meishiwei Workshop — DIY Watch Product Photography
en.summary: Still-life photography of finished watches from Meishiwei Workshop's DIY project, combining collection views with close-ups of dial colours, patterns and metal case details.
en.story:
This series photographs the completed pieces from the DIY watchmaking project. Unlike the training photographs, the finished objects themselves are the focus.

Grey display trays separate the watches and set off their dial colours and patterns. Collection views allow comparisons; individual close-ups show hands, cases and dial textures. The two distances describe the series more clearly together.

I have separated the finished pieces from the training coverage to give them their own viewing sequence. Seen after the workbench story, they also make the transition from components to completed watches visible.

seo.title: DIY Watch Product Photography | RFG Studio
seo.description: Still-life photography of finished DIY watches, featuring collection views, individual close-ups, dial patterns and case details.
